bridge.narrative: Unsloth's June 18 beta lands full GLM-5.2 support -- a sparse ~753B MoE activating only a fraction of weights per token -- alongside an auto-fit memory algorithm crediting roughly 3x longer usable context, exactly the open-weight-frontier scale and memory-efficiency tooling that pushes such a model toward a sub-256GB single-node envelope.
bridge.remaining_gap: No independently demonstrated single-node run of a frontier open-weight model under 256GB; today shows tuning coverage and memory gains, not a measured footprint.
